findings.title: Fix the malformed-flow assertion so the helper can succeed
findings.body: `studioFlows()` deliberately accepts the design-document contract before narrowing `flows` itself; when `flows.review` is `null`, it throws `Error('Invalid Prism flow')`, not an error containing `PRISM_INPUT_INVALID`. The assertion therefore always throws, the outer catch sets `NATIVE_VALIDATION_STOPPED` and a nonzero exit code, and the documented `set -e` command cannot produce the promised result files. Match `Invalid Prism flow` here, or make the negative fixture violate the Prism schema instead.

overall_explanation: The new quality-validation workflow fails its own malformed-flow assertion on every otherwise-valid invocation, so its documented success path is unusable.
